name: orarium
description: ORARIUM — a single-file, offline app that defines time on the Moon, Mars and every body of the Solar System.
author: Alexandru-Ionuț Chiuță (Alexio)

scripts.build: python3 tools/build.py && node ../chiuta.github.io/fff-kit/pwa/pwa.mjs apply . --slug orarium --name ORARIUM --categories education,utilities && node ../chiuta.github.io/fff-kit/build.mjs info . --slug orarium
scripts.test: node tools/exercise.js index.html ro && node tools/exercise.js index.html en
